ayahs.text: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,

ayahs.text: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا

tr.sahih: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
tr.pickthall: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا

tr.sahih: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
tr.pickthall: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا

tr.sahih: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
tr.pickthall: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا

tr.sahih: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
tr.pickthall: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا

tr.sahih: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
tr.pickthall: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا

tr.sahih: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
tr.pickthall: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا

tr.sahih: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
tr.pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا

tr.sahih: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
tr.pickthall: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا

tr.sahih: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
tr.pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا

tr.sahih: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
tr.pickthall: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا

tr.sahih: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
tr.pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا

tr.sahih: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
tr.pickthall: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا

tr.sahih: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
tr.pickthall: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.

ayahs.text: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا

tr.sahih: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
tr.pickthall: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.

ayahs.text: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا

words.gloss: surely We (would) have given them to drink

tr.sahih: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
tr.pickthall: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance

ayahs.text: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا

tr.sahih: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
tr.pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا

tr.sahih: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
tr.pickthall: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا

tr.sahih: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
tr.pickthall: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.

ayahs.text: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.

ayahs.text: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا

tr.sahih: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
tr.pickthall: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.

ayahs.text: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا

tr.sahih: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
tr.pickthall: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him

ayahs.text: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

tr.sahih: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
tr.pickthall: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.

ayahs.text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا

tr.sahih: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
tr.pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.

ayahs.text: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا

tr.sahih: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.

ayahs.text: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

tr.sahih: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
tr.pickthall: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,

ayahs.text: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا

tr.sahih: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
tr.pickthall: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him

ayahs.text: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا

tr.sahih: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
tr.pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
